            digest TEXT NOT NULL, enabled INTEGER NOT NULL, received INTEGER NOT NULL,
            payload TEXT NOT NULL)
notices: CREATE TABLE admins(name TEXT PRIMARY KEY, digest TEXT NOT NULL, active INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE device_admins(device TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, active INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE edit_operations(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,request TEXT NOT NULL,result TEXT NOT NULL,device TEXT NOT NULL,before_value TEXT NOT NULL,after_value TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE events(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE revisions(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,value TEXT NOT NULL)
registry: CREATE TABLE challenges(nonce TEXT PRIMARY KEY, device TEXT NOT NULL, public TEXT NOT NULL,wg TEXT NOT NULL,purpose TEXT NOT NULL,invite TEXT,expires INTEGER NOT NULL,used INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)
CREATE TABLE chat_bindings (device TEXT PRIMARY KEY, public TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, support_sender TEXT)

CREATE TABLE chat_challenges (
                nonce TEXT PRIMARY KEY, device TEXT NOT NULL, public TEXT NOT NULL,
                expires INTEGER NOT NULL, used INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)
CREATE TABLE chat_sequence (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), value INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE chat_service_senders (
                public TEXT PRIMARY KEY, enabled INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(enabled IN (0,1)))

CREATE TABLE device_support (device TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES devices(device), support_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, platform TEXT, app_version TEXT, version_code INTEGER, last_seen INTEGER, observation_source TEXT)
CREATE TABLE devices(device TEXT PRIMARY KEY, public TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, wg TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, tcp TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, revoked INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)
CREATE TABLE field_support_audit (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, timestamp INTEGER NOT NULL, support_id TEXT NOT NULL, previous_state INTEGER NOT NULL, new_state INTEGER NOT NULL, outcome TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE gateway_assignment_events (operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, request_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, device TEXT NOT NULL, previous_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, catalog_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE gateway_assignments (device TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES devices(device), catalog_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, node TEXT NOT NULL, sequence INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TRIGGER gateway_events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON gateway_assignment_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'append-only routing evidence'); END
CREATE TRIGGER gateway_events_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON gateway_assignment_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'append-only routing evidence'); END
CREATE TABLE gateway_routing_state (singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1), policy_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, generation INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE gateway_selection_events (operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, request_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, catalog_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, policy_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, sequence INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE)
CREATE TRIGGER gateway_selection_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON gateway_selection_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'append-only'); END
CREATE TRIGGER gateway_selection_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON gateway_selection_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'append-only'); END
CREATE TABLE invites(hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY, device TEXT UNIQUE, revoked INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)
CREATE TRIGGER paid_beta_binding BEFORE UPDATE OF device ON paid_beta_subscriptions WHEN NEW.device!=OLD.device BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'PAID_DEVICE_IMMUTABLE'); END

CREATE TRIGGER paid_beta_cohort_limit BEFORE INSERT ON paid_beta_subscriptions WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM paid_beta_subscriptions)>=10 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM paid_beta_subscriptions WHERE device=NEW.device) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'PAID_COHORT_LIMIT'); END
CREATE TRIGGER paid_beta_event_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON paid_beta_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'PAID_EVENT_IMMUTABLE'); END
CREATE TRIGGER paid_beta_event_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON paid_beta_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'PAID_EVENT_IMMUTABLE'); END

CREATE TABLE paid_beta_events (event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, device TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES devices(device), event_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(event_type IN ('payment','grace','expire','revoke')), occurred_at INTEGER NOT NULL, previous_state TEXT, new_state TEXT NOT NULL, period_start INTEGER NOT NULL, paid_until INTEGER NOT NULL, grace_until INTEGER, reference_hash TEXT NOT NULL, payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL, applied_at INTEGER NOT NULL, result TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(result='APPLIED'))
CREATE TRIGGER paid_beta_no_unenroll BEFORE DELETE ON paid_beta_subscriptions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'PAID_COHORT_RETAINED'); END
CREATE TRIGGER paid_beta_revocation_terminal BEFORE UPDATE ON paid_beta_subscriptions WHEN OLD.state='revoked' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'PAID_REVOKED'); END

CREATE TABLE paid_beta_subscriptions (device TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES devices(device), state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('trial','active','grace','expired','revoked')), period_start INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(period_start>=0), paid_until INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(paid_until>period_start), grace_until INTEGER CHECK(grace_until IS NULL OR grace_until>=paid_until), created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version>0), last_event_id TEXT NOT NULL, revoked_at INTEGER, CHECK(state!='grace' OR grace_until IS NOT NULL), CHECK((state='revoked')=(revoked_at IS NOT NULL)))

CREATE TABLE referral_claims (
                request TEXT PRIMARY KEY, sponsor TEXT NOT NULL, invite TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
                created INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE referral_links (token TEXT PRIMARY KEY, sponsor TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE restricted_certificates (device TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL, serial TEXT PRIMARY KEY, expires INTEGER NOT NULL, certificate TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE restricted_challenges (nonce TEXT PRIMARY KEY, revision INTEGER NOT NULL, family TEXT NOT NULL, expires INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE restricted_crl_sequence (singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1), sequence INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE restricted_grants (device TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES devices(device), family TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL, expires INTEGER, revoked INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE restricted_readiness_results (correlation TEXT PRIMARY KEY, nonce TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, device TEXT NOT NULL, challenge_at INTEGER NOT NULL, fetch_id TEXT, fetch_at INTEGER, revision INTEGER, minimum_crl INTEGER, expires INTEGER, ack TEXT, ack_at INTEGER, gateway_binding TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '')
